JOIN FORCES. MAKE DIGITALIZATION HAPPEN.
q.beyond is the leading IT partner for SMEs. We solve the technological challenges our European customers face and make their business models fit for the future. This way, we sustainably enhance our customers’ business value. We do so by implementing sovereign IT solutions and drawing on our proprietary, certified AI data centres.
Our strong team of more than 1,000 specialists combines sector expertise with technical excellence. Core focuses of our activities include public and private clouds, operating business-critical applications based on Microsoft and SAP technologies, artificial intelligence, and IT security. Publicly listed, q.beyond is present across Germany and has locations in Latvia, Spain, Romania, India, and the USA.
Design future-proof IT solutions with us as IT Operations Engineer 24/7 (m/f/d) – Generalist Network & Managed OS at our location in Cluj-Napoca.
 Your Tasks
2nd/3rd level IT operations in a 24/7 rotating shift team (not a first-level service desk)
Monitoring of customer systems and response to alerts according to SLAs.
Taking over and resolving escalated incidents, including root cause analysis on server, network and cloud level.
Operations desk and extended workbench for the one.operate hubs: service requests, standard changes,recurring maintenance.
Execution of planned changes in maintenance windows according to runbooks.
Operation of Linux (SUSE, Red Hat, Ubuntu) and Windows Server environments.
Troubleshooting of LAN, WAN, VPN and firewall issues.
Support of customer workloads in Microsoft Azure.
Involving the on-call service when specialist expertise is needed.
Documentation in ticketing system and knowledge base, automation of recurring tasks on dedicated project days.
 What We Offer You
Continue your journey: Expand your professional horizons and explore exciting internal development opportunities and a wide range of training programs
Experience the difference: Receive respect and appreciation from your colleagues and take advantage of the diverse offerings of our diversity management
Look into the future: Work with the latest technologies and the constant innovations
Find the balance: Benefit from our mix of trust-based working hours and flexible work location (hybrid roles) for a great work-life integration
Feel well taken care of: We provide you a company healthcare program and meal vouchers
Unplug and relax: 25 days of vacation
 What You Bring
Vocational training in IT (e.g. FachinformatikerSystemintegration) or a comparable degree.
At least 2 years of experience in IT operations, ideally in managed services or a data centre.
Solid networking knowledge: TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, DNS,DHCP, VPN.
Hands-on Linux administration on the command line.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory.
Experience with monitoring tools and ITSM ticketing systems.
Willingness to work 24/7 rotating shifts including nights, weekends and public holidays.
Very good English; German is an advantage.
 Nice to have : Microsoft Azure (e.g. AZ-104), LPIC or CCNA, scripting in Bash, PowerShell or Python.
APPLY QUICKLY. RECEIVE FEEDBACK.
You can apply quickly and easily without a cover letter . Simply upload your CV and certificates online on our job portal.
Inclusion is important to us. We explicitly welcome applications from people with severe disabilities and those with equivalent status.
